newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Johor Land debuts at 4.60 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Johor Land debuts at 4.60 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Johor Land Bhd made its debut on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 4.60 ringgit against an initial offer price of 2.20 ringgit.
The company offered 15 million shares to the public.
At 0142 GMT the stock was trading at 4.92 ringgit.
The company has estimated a group pre-tax profit of 33.36 million ringgit for the year ending December 31 1996, and 42.28 million ringgit for the following year.
Johor Land is an integrated property developer with activities in the manufacture of buildings materials, construction and property investment.

"The niche it has in the construction of low and medium cost houses gives a promising start for the Johor Land group," said Mayban Securities Research in a report on the company. "The fair value... should be around 5.38 to 5.98 ringgit," Mayban said.
